title: Amazing bank however room for improvement!
body:
Dear ADCB Team,

I wanted to take a moment to express my appreciation for the exceptional services your bank provides. ADCB is, without a doubt, one of the best—if not the best—banks in the UAE. Your user-friendly app, outstanding customer support, and commitment to eco-friendly banking truly set you apart.

That said, I believe there are still a couple of areas where things could be even better:
	1.	PDF confirmation of transfers: It would be incredibly helpful if a PDF receipt could be generated automatically after each transfer—instantly available in the app once initiated, and optionally sent via email once completed. Importantly, this PDF should exclude any balance details for privacy.
	2.	Business accounts for virtual office holders: This is a personal request. I currently hold a business account with RAKBANK, which I opened early on when I was less experienced. Over time, I’ve held savings accounts with many leading banks in the UAE—ENBD, FAB, Mashreq, CBD, and RAKBANK—but I ultimately chose to stay with ADCB because your service quality, app functionality, and overall banking experience are far superior.

I especially appreciate the simplicity and eco-conscious design, the seamless access to e-statements, IBAN sharing, and even the ability to generate custom e-statements. All of these features have solved issues I encountered with other banks.

Now, I am eager to move my business banking to ADCB as well. However, I’ve noticed that there currently isn’t a business account offering for virtual office setups. I would sincerely appreciate it if ADCB could consider introducing such an option, as I would be honored to become a business client in addition to a personal one.

Thank you once again for your continued excellence.

Warm regards,
author: Manav Mahendru

reply.body:
Hi Manav, thank you for you high star rating. Means a lot to us!

body:
The ADCB app is so worst that it takes more than 5 mins to login. Repeatedly gives error unable to serve your request. Your session has timed out etc. After trying for 5 mins then it logs you in once. Also the banking service is bad. Local transfers take painfully long. Also they had blocked my credit cards and even after expiry they haves sent me the renewed cards. The debit card is also expired and I haven’t received the renewed card.
I have decided to close my account with them. I will not recommend ADCB to anyone. Stay away from this bank. All other banks complete local payments in few minutes. It has been more than 12 hours now and the status of my local payment transfer still shows are in progress. While my transfers thru other banks like FAB Citi WIO takes not more than few minutes. I recommend to stay away from ADCB.
